verdict.reason: My frozen Opus overall is 252.4/32 = 7.8875, 7.9 half-up, below 8.0. The round3 fixes are real and visible (reader phone 2x2 + full sender, compose picker face and aligned phone margins, contacts phone rows, all six selection actions visible), but the set still shows small repeated slips: 16px page-header and editor add-button labels beside 14px shell, footer and menu labels; split name disclosures in the contact editor; 13px native checkboxes with no mixed select-all state; uneven security-check status on login; an 8px title inset on the phone editor and 16 vs 20px page insets on phone. None is broken; I do not ask for scope beyond these small fixes. Parent decides progression.
